title: Understanding k-Medians
text: In k-Medians, the cluster center is the median of the data points in the cluster. How does this differ from k-Means, where the center is the mean?

title: Initial Cluster Centers
text: The initial cluster centers are at $$2$$ and $$7$$. Consider which data points are closer to each center.

title: Reassigning Data Points
text: For each data point, determine which cluster center it is closest to. This will help you decide which data points belong to each cluster.

title: Calculating the Median for Cluster $$1$$
text: If the data points in the first cluster are $$1$$, $$1$$, $$1$$, and $$3$$, what is the median of these points?

title: Calculating the Median for Cluster $$2$$
text: If the data points in the second cluster are $$4$$, $$5$$, $$6$$, and $$8$$, what is the median of these points?
